Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.orgchart.ui.agenda

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.orgchart.ui.agenda
  • Class
    Description
    Agenda3D
    A native 3D week-agenda that reads the desktop-wide address book (through ContactDirectory, an adapter over org.jdesktop.lg3d.contacts.ContactStore in lg3d-core) that the production Contacts app edits.
    AgendaButton
    A small labelled push button for the agenda control strip, drawn entirely at runtime into a texture (no PNG assets) so it matches the glassy vocabulary without shipping images.
    AgendaGrid
    A week-view agenda grid rendered entirely at runtime into a single texture: seven day columns (Mon..Sun) by 10 one-hour rows starting at AgendaGrid.START_HOUR.
    AgendaGrid.GridListener
    Notified whenever a click changes the selection or creation cursor.
    AgendaPanel
    The 2D/Swing counterpart of the native-3D Agenda3D week agenda.
    Appointment
    A single user-created agenda entry: a titled block on the week grid that optionally invites one or more contacts from the shared /contacts store populated by Contact3D.
    AppointmentStore
    Persists the user-created agenda to the Preferences tree, mirroring the way Contact3D stores contacts under /contacts.
    ContactDirectory
    Read-only view of the desktop-wide address book for the agenda / mail UIs.
    ContactDirectory.ContactInfo
    A lightweight, immutable snapshot of one contact for the agenda UI.
    InvitationBuilder
    Builds a real RFC 5545 iCalendar meeting request for an Appointment: the text/calendar payload with METHOD:REQUEST (so the recipient's mail client offers accept / tentative / decline), the human-readable invitation draft around it, and the invite.ics attachment that carries the payload.
    InvitationSender
    Sends real meeting invitations for an Appointment: it resolves the desktop's default mail account, composes the RFC 5545 METHOD:REQUEST payload with InvitationBuilder, and hands the draft plus its invite.ics attachment to the mail app's existing Jakarta Mail backend through MailSessionManager.
